```{r add link to github repo, echo = FALSE, results='asis'}

# print link to github repo if any
if (file.exists("./.git/config")){
  config <- readLines("./.git/config")
  url <- grep("url",  config, value = TRUE)
  url <- gsub("\\turl = |.git$", "", url)
  cat("\nSource code and data found at [", url, "](", url, ")", sep = "")
  }

```

```{r load packages, message = FALSE}

# packages to use: CRAN name, "bioc::package" for Bioconductor,
# "user/repo" for GitHub (e.g. "maRce10/Rraven")
# knitr is required for creating html/pdf/word reports
# formatR is used for soft-wrapping code
packages <- c("kableExtra", "knitr", "formatR", "rprojroot")

# package names (specification without source prefix or version)
# note: won't work if a GitHub repo name differs from its package name
package_names <- sub(".*[/:]", "", sub("@.*$", "", packages))

# install missing packages (with pak)
missing <- !vapply(package_names, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
if (any(missing)) {
  if (!requireNamespace("pak", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("pak")
  try(pak::pkg_install(packages[missing]), silent = TRUE)

  # stop with a clear message if any package could not be installed/loaded
  missing <- !vapply(package_names, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
  if (any(missing))
    stop("These packages could not be installed or loaded: ",
         paste(packages[missing], collapse = ", "),
         "\nIf they were just installed, restart R and render again (packages already loaded may have been updated).",
         "\nOtherwise run pak::pkg_install(c(\"", paste(packages[missing], collapse = "\", \""),
         "\")) to see the details", call. = FALSE)
}

# load packages
invisible(lapply(package_names, library, character.only = TRUE))

```

<!-- add a copy button to each code block -->
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  var icons = {
    copy: '<i class="fa fa-clipboard"></i>',
    done: '<i class="fa fa-check" style="color: #90BE6D"></i>',
    fail: '<i class="fa fa-times-circle" style="color: #F94144"></i>'
  };

  // fallback when the clipboard API is not available or not allowed
  function copyFallback(text) {
    var area = document.createElement("textarea");
    area.value = text;
    area.style.position = "fixed";
    area.style.opacity = "0";
    document.body.appendChild(area);
    area.select();
    var ok = false;
    try { ok = document.execCommand("copy"); } catch (e) {}
    document.body.removeChild(area);
    return ok ? Promise.resolve() : Promise.reject();
  }

  function copyText(text) {
    if (navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext)
      return navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).catch(function () { return copyFallback(text); });
    return copyFallback(text);
  }

  document.querySelectorAll("pre.sourceCode, pre.r").forEach(function (pre) {
    var button = document.createElement("button");
    button.type = "button";
    button.className = "copy-code-btn";
    button.title = "Copy code";
    button.innerHTML = icons.copy;
    button.addEventListener("click", function () {
      var code = pre.querySelector("code") || pre;
      copyText(code.innerText).then(
        function () { button.innerHTML = icons.done; },
        function () { button.innerHTML = icons.fail; }
      );
      setTimeout(function () { button.innerHTML = icons.copy; }, 2000);
    });
    // add button to the (non-scrolling) code block container
    var box = pre.parentElement.classList.contains("sourceCode") ? pre.parentElement : pre;
    box.classList.add("has-copy-btn");
    box.appendChild(button);
  });
});
</script>
